name: Boise Spring 2020
information: # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Please make sure you know all of the WCA regulations. If you haven't attended a competition before or even would just like a refresher on how they work, please show up for the competitor tutorial at 8:30am. It is also recommended to watch the [tutorial video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) about how WCA competitions work. If you are in the Boise area, please consider joining the [Boise Speedcubing Club](https://www.facebook.com/boisespeedcubing/) to meet other members of the community and influence future competitions!
